CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified contents was found.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red cell set) and its organization/origin metadata are both explicitly reported for the same referent and time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim tied to a listed content's organization/presentation/access was present.

C.rationale: The report explicitly lists identified contents with attributes (color) and coordinate sets for current and candidate referents.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are reported separately from origin/organization metadata for the same referent, indicating a distinction between identification and status/organization.

O.rationale: The text describes how content is organized/presented (grid orientation) and includes explicit origin/organization metadata tied to current referents.
